title: Reversing a sublist by moving nodes to its front

steps.caption: Reverse positions 2..4. Walk prev to the node just before the sublist (value 1). The sublist's first node (2) will end up last.
Take the node after `start` (3) and move it right after prev. The sublist's front is now 3.
Take the node after `start` (4) and move it right after prev. The sublist's front is now 4.
right − left moves, each O(1): the sublist is reversed and still connected on both ends. One pass, O(1) space.
